# Midnight Coder

> Midnight Coder is a local-first AI coding agent with explicit model, context, sandbox, and approval controls.

Midnight Coder runs from the developer's workspace and provides a terminal workflow, local model provider discovery, bounded conversation context, an app server, and Python and TypeScript SDK surfaces.

## Core pages

- [Product overview](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/): Features, commands, installation, and project links.
- [Local AI coding agent](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/local-ai-coding-agent/): Definition, architecture, use cases, and tradeoffs.
- [Ollama coding agent](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/ollama-coding-agent/): Local provider setup and smart context sizing.
- [Installation](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/install-midnight-coder/): npm requirements, installation, and verification.
- [Context management](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/context-management/): Context windows, compaction, resume strategy, and commands.
- [Integrations](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/integrations/): Terminal, app server, Python SDK, and TypeScript SDK.
- [Local LLM inference](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/local-llm-inference/): Providers, endpoints, hardware, quantization, context, and privacy.
- [AI coding agent security](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/ai-coding-agent-security/): Sandbox, approvals, workspace scope, network access, and secrets.
- [AI coding glossary](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/ai-coding-glossary/): Definitions for AI, LLM, inference, tokens, agents, tools, context, APIs, and integrations.
- [AI code assistant](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/ai-code-assistant/): Completion, generation, pair programming, agents, and selection criteria.
- [Open source coding agent](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/open-source-coding-agent/): Local-first, self-hosted, offline, and privacy-first boundaries.
- [Local code LLMs](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/local-code-llms/): Provider boundaries for Ollama, GGUF, llama.cpp, Qwen Coder, and DeepSeek Coder.
- [AI coding hardware](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/ai-coding-hardware/): GPU inference, AMD, RX 580, low VRAM, quantization, and monitoring boundaries.
- [Coding agent alternatives](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/coding-agent-alternatives/): A verified framework for evaluating Midnight Coder as an alternative.
- [Agentic coding workflow](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/agentic-coding-workflow/): Repository tools, multi-file work, SmartContext, and compaction.
- [AI coding for developers](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/ai-coding-for-developers/): Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React, backend, full-stack, and DevOps contexts.
- [Enterprise AI coding](https://midnightcoderagent.github.io/enterprise-ai-coding/): Technical controls, review requirements, unsupported claims, and pilot scope.
